rules.arithmetic: IEEE doubles, operations in the order below; cents(x) = floor(x * 100 + 0.5) / 100, applied only to each line amount, the floor, margin and the target price.
rules.load_ratio: min((load_kg / 1000) / capacity_t, 1); 1 when capacity or load is unknown
rules.empty_return: one-way only: include_empty_return if not null, else settings.include_empty_return_default (true) and distance_km >= settings.empty_return_min_km (300)
rules.km_loaded: distance_km * (2 if ROUND_TRIP else 1); km_empty = distance_km when the empty return is included
rules.litres: litres_loaded = km_loaded * burn_loaded / 100; litres_empty = km_empty * burn_empty / 100
rules.tolls: cents(tolls.one_way * legs_loaded); tolls_return = cents(tolls.empty_return ?? tolls.one_way); unknown (null / lookup_failed) -> null + tolls_unknown unless confirmed_none (then 0)
rules.nights: nights(h) = max(ceil(h / hours_per_day) - 1, 0), h = duration_minutes / 60; loaded = nights(h) one-way, nights(2h) round trip; return extra = nights(2h) - nights(h)
rules.driver: driver.amount if given, else cents(nights * allowance_per_night) (0 when nights = 0)
rules.floor: cents(sum of line amounts); null when any line is unknown
rules.diesel: override_price -> override; OWN (own_price set, not use_official) -> own; else official_price -> official; else missing
rules.diesel_own_off: |own - official| / official > 0.03; impact_zar = cents((own - official) * litres_total)
rules.compare: lines[].amount, floor, floor_known, target_price, margin: exact to the cent. warnings: code, severity, impact_zar exact; title/detail are server copy. litres / burn: within 1e-9.
